hero_subhead: An IP and leadership-infrastructure ecosystem — where ideas become infrastructure, and infrastructure becomes legacy.

mission_quote.text: To build leadership infrastructure that empowers people and organizations to transform
into performance, sustainable enterprise value, and lasting legacy.

vision_body_prefix: A world where infrastructure is built around human potential — rather than people being forced to conform to infrastructure that was never designed for
problem_headline: Most infrastructure is built first. Then humans are expected to adapt.
problem_body: We reverse that model. Traditional: design, deploy, train, hope for adoption. Ours: understand the human first, then build infrastructure around them.
phases_eyebrow: How we work — the IV Phases™ model

phases.title: Foundations
phases.description: Know who you are and what you stand on.

phases.title: Infrastructure Planning & Management
phases.description: Decide what to build and how it connects.

phases.title: Internal Operating Systems
phases.description: Building the systems, processes, structures, tools, and leadership mechanisms that let the organization function.

phases.title: Preservation
phases.description: Make it last beyond any one person.

model_headline: Not a linear funnel. Value moves in every direction.
model_body: Not a single-purpose consulting business. Value moves between people, ideas, products, organizations, and community — with many ways in, all connected to Leadership Infrastructure™.
ethics_body: Built on ethics. How we treat people is part of the infrastructure.

audiences.title: Founders Organization
audiences.description: Companies partnering with The Co.LLab™ — their participation builds Leadership Infrastructure™ and moves value back through the ecosystem.

audiences.title: Corporate / Enterprise
audiences.description: Organizations building infrastructure behind their leadership.

audiences.title: .LLab™ Products & Membership
audiences.description: Leaders accessing frameworks and tools directly.

audiences.title: Creator Infrastructure™
audiences.description: Leadership Infrastructure™ for every kind of creative venture. Creators keep ownership of their IP; The Co.LLab™ builds the infrastructure around it.

ip_headline: Ideas → Research → Theory → Framework → Infrastructure → Product → Licensing → Enterprise.
ip_body: Frameworks, models, research, products, and creative IP — given a visible architecture instead of kept hidden.
personality_body: Academic, not boring. Corporate, not sterile. Creative, not chaotic. Serious about ideas — with room for the delightfully ridiculous. That's the R.A.T.™ spirit.
community_body: You don't have to agree to belong. Question, disagree, explore — with respect. No hate. Built for people who think and build.
closing_eyebrow: The idea behind all of it
closing_body_prefix: For people. Leaders. Founders. Organizations. Artists. Creators. Enterprises. And, ultimately:
